# LibreBugBounty 2.0.1 Moneta

Moneta 2.0.1 turns the existing workspace into a continuously maintained case
inventory. Old findings are rechecked in parallel, while browser screenshots
remain isolated evidence and are captured by dedicated headed browser lanes.

## Highlights

- **Parallel stock rechecks:** four supervised workers recheck open and
  wont-fix cases every 28 days. Claims are atomic and leased, interrupted runs
  recover on their own, errors retry after three days, and cases from the same
  domain stay spaced by at least one hour. A catch-up command can pull every
  stale slot due and burn down the backlog with a configurable local worker
  fleet.
- **Visual evidence only when it matters:** the headless technical pass stays
  parallel and does not mix a screenshot into every run. A result change or a
  new `inconclusive`/`error` observation queues a separate screenshot for
  review, keeping the technical observation and visible evidence auditable as
  different records.
- **Four isolated screenshot lanes:** headed captures now run in four
  Playwright containers, each with its own Xvfb display. Queue insertion and
  job claims remain safe, but long browser captures no longer wait behind one
  global worker.
- **Screenshot backfill:** `app:screenshot:missing` now recognizes both cases
  without screenshot evidence and cases whose stored image file has become
  unreadable. Existing jobs are not duplicated.
- **Clearer automatic outcomes:** a browser-observed `fixed` result is applied
  directly and leaves the recheck scope. Only unclear outcomes require manual
  review.

## Upgrading

Create and verify a complete workspace backup first. Stop DDEV, update this
checkout, and run `ddev start`. The startup process installs locked
dependencies, applies the `nextDueAt` migration, and starts four recheck
workers plus four screenshot workers.

The first start after upgrading creates additional Playwright sidecars. On a
small machine, reduce the number of `screenshot-worker-*` entries in
`.ddev/config.yaml` and the matching `playwright-shot-*` services in
`.ddev/docker-compose.playwright.yaml`; do not point multiple workers at the
same headed screenshot sidecar.

Existing cases, observations, assessments, screenshot jobs, and evidence are
retained. If stored image files were previously lost, queue replacements with:

```bash
ddev exec php bin/console app:screenshot:missing --limit=1000
```

For rollback, restore the matching pre-upgrade database and artifacts together,
then check out the previous application version.

## Scope

LibreBugBounty remains a local, single-user reflected-XSS workspace without
authentication or multi-user permissions. Keep the web and Playwright services
local. Disclosure emails and report submission remain manual.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/tfgrass/librebugbounty/blob/v2.0.1/CHANGELOG.md)
